clue.text: Fish is sent back — affected the inside

indicators.note: the inside says the word for affected goes into the middle of the other piece
sent back tells us the little word is is to be read from right to left

parts.note: affected, as in showy and mannered, means camp

explanation.surface: Someone returns a fish dish because its inside was off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' turns IS into SI, and 'the inside' puts CAMP between its two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Large prawns served breaded are a seafood dish, loosely a fish.

clue.text: But we heard her other name

definitions.text: But we heard her other name

parts.words: But we heard her other name
parts.note: a word sounding like But, heard in concert, was her surname, and the other name is her first

explanation.walkthrough: Clara Butt was a famous English contralto of the early 1900s.
explanation.definitionFit: The singer's forename completes her name, the one besides her surname.

clue.text: Pit-stop full of perils

parts.note: a pit is a mine
in cricket, to field the ball is to stop it

explanation.surface: A stop in the pits during a race turns out to be hazardous.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the answer loosely: the answer is an area full of perils.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground sown with buried explosives is the image for a situation bristling with hidden dangers.

clue.text: When at home, gobble up what comes in

parts.note: someone at home is said to be in

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for gobble is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to gobble food is to wolf it

explanation.surface: Someone at home eats greedily whatever arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: An influx of water, money or people is the amount that arrives.

clue.text: Take one's place to eat something vegetarian

parts.note: to sup is to eat an evening meal
a plant is a vegetable growth, something a vegetarian might eat

explanation.surface: A guest takes their seat at the table to have a meatless meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To usurp or replace someone is to step into their position.

clue.text: The last age of man, next to the first

parts.note: next to the first in order is second
the first age of man is childhood

explanation.surface: Old age is described as coming right after the first stage of life.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's Seven Ages of Man end in 'second childishness', the dotage of extreme old age.
explanation.definitionFit: Senile dotage, when the old become helpless again, is the final stage of life.

clue.text: Distribution of gifts — lot damaged, in repair

indicators.note: in says the rearranged letters go inside the word for repair

parts.note: to repair a hole is to patch it

indicators.note: damaged means the word lot is knocked out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: Some gifts handed out were damaged and needed mending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' turns LOT into OTL, which goes inside PATCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Among Pacific Northwest peoples, a ceremonial feast where a host gives away possessions.

clue.text: Deposit for a house

explanation.surface: Paying a down payment on a home.
explanation.definitionFit: To deposit something is to lodge it, as with a bank; and a lodge is a small house, such as a gatekeeper's.

clue.text: Young couple in Welwyn working with pressmen

indicators.note: working means set in motion and rearranged, so the letters of Welwyn are shuffled

parts.note: editors, newspaper men, are eds

explanation.surface: A young pair in the Hertfordshire town of Welwyn work alongside journalists.
explanation.walkthrough: Welwyn is a town north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: A just-married pair are recently wed spouses.

clue.text: A sacred song and perhaps a comic one: in fact, that's fashionable

parts.note: a comic is a kind of magazine, a mag

indicators.note: fashionable read as fashioned anew signals that the letters are reshaped into a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hymn is likened to a comic song that happens to be trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashionable' looks like IN, but it is the anagram signal: I with IN FACT rearranges to NIFICAT, after MAG.
explanation.definitionFit: The canticle of the Virgin Mary sung at Vespers is a hymn of praise from Luke's gospel.

clue.text: Some of the lights are blue

explanation.surface: Some lamps are tinted a cold colour.
explanation.definitionFit: In a crossword, the lights are the entries, half of them running vertically; and feeling blue means feeling low and sad.

clue.text: Type of spectacles for the partially-sighted?

definitions.text: Type of spectacles for the partially-sighted?

parts.words: Type of spectacles for the partially-sighted?
parts.note: reading glasses with lenses cut in half, which a joker might say suit someone who sees only partly

explanation.definitionFit: Reading glasses shaped like a semicircle, worn low on the nose, are named after the shape of the moon in its quarter phase.

clue.text: Lemur heard aboard ship

explanation.surface: A lemur's call is heard on board a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A Madagascan primate with long fingers shares its name with the sailor's reply of obedience, 'yes, yes, sir'.

clue.text: Said to be the top pet

indicators.note: said to be tells us the word is spoken, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: the top of a mountain is its peak

explanation.surface: Someone claims a particular animal is the best pet of all.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pekingese is a small lapdog, kept as a domestic animal.

clue.text: To be a real mess, get worked up

indicators.note: mess here, like making a mess of, means the preceding letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone getting agitated about things being chaotic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mess' rearranges TO BE A REAL; 'get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something developed in detail is intricate, carefully worked out.

clue.text: Example of coolness in the sea

explanation.surface: A calm person is spotted swimming in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbially one is cool as this salad vegetable, and the sea variety is a marine animal related to starfish.

clue.text: It produces lots of circuits for very little token money

parts.note: micro means very small
a chip is a token used as money at a casino

explanation.surface: A gadget delivering many circuits for a tiny coin.
explanation.definitionFit: An integrated circuit on a sliver of silicon carries a host of tiny electronic circuits.

clue.text: German is in a French town — with these companions?

indicators.note: in says the German word is placed inside the town's name

parts.note: Tours is a city on the Loire
ist is the German for is

explanation.surface: A German visits a French town, and the question is who travels with him.
explanation.definitionFit: Visitors sightseeing in a French town would have fellow holidaymakers as companions.

clue.text: Put it back to conceal an entrance to restaurant perhaps

indicators.note: to conceal means the turned word hides the other pieces inside it
back, with Put, says the little word it is turned round

parts.note: an entrance is a door

explanation.surface: A diner is told to put something back so as to hide a restaurant doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns IT into TI, and 'to conceal' puts AN DOOR between its letters. The definition describes a kind of Indian restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian eateries are often described by this clay-oven cooking style, so it qualifies a type of restaurant.

clue.text: Twisted appearance of sculptor's work

explanation.surface: A statue by a sculptor has a contorted look.
explanation.definitionFit: A squint or warped look in the eye is called this, and a sculptor's figure made by pouring metal into a mould is one too.

clue.text: Means of admission to the French course

parts.note: a gate is a way in
au is French for to the

explanation.surface: Getting into a French cookery course.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich cake served as dessert is a course of a meal.

clue.text: Matron giving woman a preliminary examination

indicators.note: a preliminary means the examination comes before the woman

parts.note: the MOT is the annual roadworthiness test for vehicles in Britain
her stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A hospital matron gives a female patient an initial check-up.
explanation.walkthrough: MOT is the yearly safety test that British cars must pass.
explanation.definitionFit: A matron is a married woman with children, a dignified parent figure.

clue.text: Why there is no egg in the hair dye?

parts.note: an egg comes from a hen, so the egg's absence points to the bird
N/A stands for not available, as when there is none

explanation.surface: Someone wonders why egg is missing from a hair-colouring mixture.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer split as HEN N/A, a hen not available, explains why there is no egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish plant extract is used to colour hair and skin.

clue.text: In old Aga wrinkled line appears

indicators.note: wrinkled suggests something creased and out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A slanting mark shows up on an ancient, crumpled Aga cooker.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy British range cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A slanting stroke joining opposite corners is a kind of straight line.

clue.text: Businessman is from the upper class, in short

indicators.note: in short says the long phrase is cut down to its abbreviated form

parts.note: someone from the upper class is a gentleman

explanation.surface: A businessman comes from a posh background, briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in short' cuts A GENTLEMAN to A GENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A representative who conducts deals for others is a commercial man.

clue.text: Sound chap, Thomas

indicators.note: Sound here means spoken aloud, so the word for chap is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a chap is a man

explanation.surface: Thomas is called a sound fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas is the first name of the German novelist who wrote The Magic Mountain.

clue.text: Page of Mozart, perhaps, marked with runs?

explanation.surface: A page of Mozart's music has notes running up and down it.
explanation.definitionFit: A page of written music is a score sheet, and in cricket the record where runs are entered is a scoresheet.

clue.text: Went back to Vanbrugh's work "The Origin of Drama

parts.note: The Relapse is a Restoration comedy by Sir John Vanbrugh

indicators.note: origin of points to the very start of the next word, its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone turned to a Vanbrugh play titled as a study of how drama began.
explanation.walkthrough: Vanbrugh was an English playwright and architect of the late 1600s.
explanation.definitionFit: To relapse is to slide back into a former state, so it means fell back.

clue.text: Arrogant, but raised sympathy

parts.note: raised means lifted up
sympathy means pity

explanation.surface: A proud person nonetheless showed compassion.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who forgets their place and acts superior is haughty and presumptuous.
